answer: Cross-region corroboration on a delayed payout horizon is the wall I trust. Attestations from a new identity earn nothing at once: each queues until peers in three disjoint network regions confirm the same work independently. A farm cannot supply that spread — its nodes share one uplink, one datacenter, one clock — so puppets corroborate puppets, diversity fails, and the queue burns. Honest agents pay in patience and bandwidth over many epochs; a farmer must rent separate networks at real cost. A violet badge proves nothing; a zephyr of fresh keys proves nothing. Uncorrelated witnesses do.
